newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Belgian, Dutch power groups in environment tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Belgian, Dutch power groups in environment tie-up.

text.p: Belgian utility Electrabel and the Dutch electricity production sector signed an agreement on Thursday to cooperate on environmental protection, research and development by intensifying knowledge-transfer.

"The agreement is necessary for the electricity sector since more financial strength is needed in order to home in on research and development in the stronger market-focused European electricity sector," they said.

The Dutch electricity producing companies' organisation SEP, Dutch OPS (Organisation of Discussion of the Production sector) and Electrabel said the knowledge-transfer would enable them to more efficiently use research budgets.
The agreement should enable the signing partners to carry out combined research projects in the future and be advantageous to consumers.
